notes.title: Dungreed's next game Sephiria launches on April 3rd.
notes.content:
Dungreed's next game Sephiria launches on April 3rd.
New Game Launch
Our team's second game, Sephiria, is launching soon!
Hello! This is Team Horay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436940/Sephiria/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/7283f1feafe6baca3a75940583e0fd643115b9e6.jpg[/img]
After a long development period, our team's second game, Sephiria, is launching soon!
The release date is [u][b]April 3rd[/b][/u]! (Apr 3, 2025 6:00 PM GMT+9)

[h1]About Sephiria[/h1]

Sephiria is an action roguelite where you play as a rabbit on a quest to save a tower facing impending doom. Grow stronger in various ways through inventory placement. Fight as a powerful warrior using weapons, sweep through enemies with powerful magic, or overcome challenges with the power of artifacts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/2cf03062c7731e3f8c9a1d9893e3ec08ac915625.jpg[/img]
Sephiria Early Access includes the following content:
- 150+ different artifacts
- 3 types of weapons, each with dozens of unique upgrades
- 4 stages and multiple bosses
- Various random events
- Online multiplayer for up to 4 players

Our team is taking on the challenge of developing a multiplayer system for the first time in Sephiria. While we've consistently tested the game through internal testing and closed beta, we acknowledge that gameplay might be somewhat unstable due to this being our first development and the constantly changing game situations. We will do our best to stabilize the game so that many gamers can enjoy it without inconvenience.

Through this Early Access launch, we want to communicate closely with you and hear various opinions about different aspects of the game. We also plan to improve the game and provide new content through active patches after the Early Access launch! We will announce a detailed roadmap in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/26c75ef7f458bea0a7e410718a1f69bcbe9fc5c3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Our Second Launch[/h1]

It's already been 7 years since we released our first work, Dungreed. Although we had to abandon several projects we were developing along the way, those processes seem to have become valuable experiences for us. While it's not time to be sentimental with the launch approaching, we remember the days we've worked hard from offline exhibitions to Next Fest and demos. It would have been impossible without your support.

Sephiria might evolve completely differently from our current plans based on your feedback. While we can't predict exactly how the game will progress, we ask for your interest and feedback! ([url=https://discord.com/invite/g7AaeBuyMV]Discord Community[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/c28de876f0d6a200f68033d368a7a470b92e6d52.jpg[/img]

Until April 3rd, we will do our best to complete the finishing touches.

See you then!

notes.title: 1.7.1 Updates
notes.content:
[h1]Custom Costumes[/h1]

In 1.7.1. Patch, we mainly worked about custom costumes features.

Our goal with custom costumes was to provide an environment where you could easily create your own character, but we also recognized that simply providing stats would greatly limit your creativity. Accordingly, we developed the “conditional stats” function as an experimental feature.

Even though it has only been a short time since we released the patch, the enthusiastic feedback from many gamers has been an enjoyable experience for us. we also realize that your creativity is truly amazing! :D
Dungreed's code structure is very old and complex, so it is difficult to apply all the suggestions, but ideas that are easy to implement were reflected in this patch.

[list]
[*] Added experimental feature “Conditional Stats” [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3032557716][see guide section 4][/url]
[quote]Currently, there is a rather simple condition: "When equipped with a katana, handgun, or spear tagged weapon." We plan to make more of this and that.[/quote]
[*] Added custom costumes debugging
[quote]Now you can load custom costumes more easily in the game. Insert the file and press F5 in boutique UI. Custom costumes can be loaded instantly.[/quote]
[/list]

[h1]Steam Workshop[/h1]

There was a suggestion on the Steam Workshop and we are currently looking into it. Activating Steam Workshop took a lot more work than we expected. It will likely take some time. Thank you for your patient.


[h1]Bug fix[/h1]

[list]
[*] Polsfuss custom "Purple Beauty": Fixed an issue where the poisoning effect was not applied.
(Currently, there is a bug where the burn stats does not occur even if burn enhancement is performed on the item. This will be fixed in the future.)
[*] Fixed a bug where the game freezes when starting the trials.
[/list]

notes.title: Team News of the end of the year
notes.content:
Hello! This is TEAM HORAY.

It seems like it's the first time we've written a post that isn't a patch note.

First of all, we would like to say thank you for your interest in our team and Dungreed for a long time. 

To celebrate the coming of the new year, We want to share some of our work.




[h1]A New Game (Under Development)[/h1]

From the beginning of 2021 to the present, we are developing a new game.

The game's name is [b]Sephiria[/b]. It's a top-down view action roguelite set in a ruined world and tells the story of animals living in it. We are developing hard to make the game fun.

This is previews of the game in development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/3171d9b84f898aae71846e46cc11ffd877fb0ae4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31383556/202a8929882aeba17a0d24780b1f883b6cc4cf8e.gif[/img]

After applying this patch, save files of users who have been playing games on both Windows and macOS at the same time might be overwrited to Steam Cloud.

To back up your save files, you need to access to the path below.

Steam Library > Right click on Dungreed > Properties... > LOCAL FILES tab > BROWSE LOCAL FILES...
Windows: Dungreed_Data\\StreamingAssets\\Slot*.uml
macOS: Contents/Resources/Data/StreamingAssets/Slot*.uml

notes.title: How to use "Borderless Windowed Mode"
notes.content:
Hello.

There are people who prefer the existing borderless window mode. We will guide you how to use borderless window mode as below.


1. Library - Right Click Dungreed - Properties

2. Click "Set Launch Options"

3. Type -popupwindow

4. Run dungreed


Using the above method, you can use Borderless windowed mode.


If you have any other questions, please leave a comment or a discussion!
Thank you.
